evidence_slice: Historic England Open Data Hub service National_Heritage_List_for_England_NHLE_v02_VIEW, layer 3 'Listed Building polygons', is an official public no-login esriGeometryPolygon layer supporting JSON/GeoJSON/PBF and publishing ListEntry, Name, Grade, area_ha, NGR, Easting and Northing fields; layer metadata reports data last edit 2026-08-06 and OGL/Crown Copyright 2026. Historic England NHLE List Entry 1306502 identifies Bridge Inn, Bridge Hill, Topsham, Exeter, Grade II, first listed 1952-11-11 and most recently amended 2022-06-07; the record describes it as a C18 coaching inn/public house with former malthouse. The selected source window was the exact layer-3 GeoJSON query where ListEntry=1306502 with returnGeometry=true. That parameterized feature payload was inaccessible through the available web retrieval channel, and a direct network attempt failed at DNS resolution before any feature JSON or polygon coordinates were returned.
